topic: CoffeeMan / Amigo anonymous-cart delivery methods for the tracked single, 4-pack and 8-pack listings (500 g-3 kg carts)
method: Interactive headless Google Chrome 154.0.8037.97 + ChromeDriver 154.0.8037.92 through scripts/browser-research.mjs (npm run research:browser), one live session kept across steps. Each cart was an anonymous temporary cart built by adding the tracked product on the vendor product page; the public checkout page (https://www.coffeeman.co.il/checkout.asp, reached from the public cart link https://www.coffeeman.co.il/cart.asp) was read without submitting an order, logging in, creating an account or entering any street address or personal detail. No locality field was required to display the method prices. Cart/session identifiers, cookies and tokens are deliberately not recorded; the checkout URLs above are the public page paths with all query parameters removed.
toolingLimitation: The coding agent's file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so the saved screenshots could not be machine-inspected by the model. Every amount below is backed by the rendered visible text captured in the same live session; the screenshots are kept as artifacts for a human reviewer.
why: The 2026-10-12 18:16 UTC research covered the 8 x 250 g cart only. This batch clarifies the single/4-pack delivery methods and the free-delivery behavior the product page does not publish.

coverage.localityRestriction: The checkout method picker displayed both priced methods and the self-pickup option without asking for a locality, city or address, so the public flow cannot confirm or exclude any locality before personal order details. The vendor terms caveat already recorded in docs/SOURCES.md (home delivery subject to Amigo's unpublished locality list) therefore remains the only coverage evidence; it was neither confirmed nor refuted by the cart.
coverage.blocker: No locality/postcode field is available in the anonymous cart/checkout method picker; entering personal delivery details would be required to test a specific destination, which this research does not do.

freeDelivery.conclusion: Free delivery was observed on some larger carts but is not a published, single-threshold rule (the ₪240 8-pack cart was still charged ₪20). The board therefore keeps the published ₪25 courier rate for the single/4-pack offers and does not assume free shipping; the observations are recorded here and in the offer's shipping evidence note.
